purpose: Generate clean Korean translation worklists from original BIA .INT files

stage37_correction.reason: Stage37 guessed CP949/UTF-16 for original Western game files, creating false Hangul syllables from cp1252/ASCII bytes. Observed garbage included 뀠/뼊/윊/췗. The only meaningful Korean strings were earlier font test artifacts such as 한글테스트/한글B.

next_step: Translate stage38 batch TSV files. After completed translations are merged, recalculate the actual U+AC00..U+D7A3 corpus and build the production atlas.
